# Equity volatility surface (`equity-vol-surface` v1)

Implied vols by expiry and moneyness.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `EQV` · **Identifiers:** `EQV-…` in `surfaceId`

Open one with `EQV <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: equity-vol-surface
version: 1
description: Implied vols by expiry and moneyness.
match: { kind: equity-vol-surface, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Equity volatility surface, id: $.surfaceId }
strip:
  - { label: Underlier, bind: $.underlier }
  - { label: "1M ATM", bind: $.atm1m, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: "1Y ATM", bind: $.atm1y, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: "1Y skew (90–110)", bind: $.skew1y, fmt: price2, tone: sign }
panels:
  - id: surface
    kind: surface
    title: Implied vol by expiry × moneyness (%)
    code: SURF
    key: F4
    rows: $.grid
    y: expiry
    columns:
      - { label: "80%", bind: "@.m80", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "90%", bind: "@.m90", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "100%", bind: "@.m100", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "110%", bind: "@.m110", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "120%", bind: "@.m120", fmt: price2 }
  - id: grid
    kind: table
    title: Vol (%) by moneyness
    key: F2
    rows: $.grid
    columns:
      - { label: Expiry, bind: "@.expiry" }
      - { label: "80%", bind: "@.m80", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "90%", bind: "@.m90", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "100%", bind: "@.m100", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "110%", bind: "@.m110", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "120%", bind: "@.m120", fmt: price2 }
  - id: atm
    kind: line
    title: ATM term structure
    area: right
    rows: $.grid
    x: expiry
    y: m100
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
